I had no network this session, so the legal text below is as quoted by earlier verifiers from the manual and the MOJ press release.

verdicts.reason: The repo shows D-10-T next = [E-7-T, F-2-T] only. The D-10 activity scope lets D-10-T holders look for work in any E-1 to E-7 field. The 2026 change lists name D-10 holders as eligible for E-7 ('D-4~D-10') and for E-3 ('D-2 / D-10 holder changing to E-3'), and both targets have `change` lists, so adding E-7-1 and E-3 is right. Two parts of the claim are wrong. D-10-T is not stuck, since F-2-T stays open for a reader who meets D-10-T's own {edu:4, rank:3}. It is also not the only D-10 code without a D-10-1 fallback, because D-10-3 lacks one too. The D-10-1 fallback is undocumented: the manual's within-status moves are only D-10-1>D-10-2, D-10-1>D-10-T and D-10-2>D-10-1, so leave it out until a source covers it.

verdicts.reason: In the repo, F-1 appears in no `next` list, NONE's included, so its six onward edges can never be reached from a path. F-1 is a current long-term status issued at consulates. The decree row covers family visits, living with family and dependants, and the 2026.9.18 manual has F-1-5, F-1-15 (Top-Tier parent, '사증발급') and the F-1-D digital-nomad visa. So NONE -> F-1 is right (`abroad: true` is redundant, since moves from NONE are always abroad). However, data/visadocs.yaml has no `abroad` list for F-1, so the edge would be a fourth exception to the abroad-edge/document invariant unless that list is transcribed. F-1 also has no gate and will show as OPEN for everyone, so the edge needs a 4-language note saying who it is for. The 2022 Visa Navigator the finding cites is outdated, but the decree row stands.

verdicts.reason: It is true that no `next` list, NONE's included, offers D-4-2 or E-6-2. But 'no reader can ever land on them or see their onward routes' is false: both are in the current-visa search list (visamap.js keeps every non-goal code), so their holders do see the onward routes. Both statuses are current in the 2026 manuals (the D-4-2K extension list; the E-6 extension list items marked 'E-6-2자격만 징구'). But data/visadocs.yaml gives neither an `abroad` list, because the E-6 CCVI list is attached to E-6-1 only, so the proposed NONE edges break the abroad-edge/document invariant. Both are also ungated and would show as OPEN to every reader. E-6-2 leads only to F-6-1/F-2-3, so offering it as a planning route needs a deliberate editorial decision (verified-by-review #6).
